newsitem.title: USA: Uni-Marts Inc to suspend dividend.
newsitem.headline: Uni-Marts Inc to suspend dividend.

text.p: Uni-Marts Inc said Monday that because of disappointing operating results, it will temporarily suspend its regular quarterly dividend, which is $0.03 per share, effective for the quarter ending July 3.
The company said the dividend will be considered for reinstatement upon the company's return to profitability.
In the second quarter, ended April 3, the compay reported a loss of $0.15 a share, versus earnings of $0.04 a share in the year-earlier period.

The company said that costs associated with expansion, plus lower-than-expected revenues, depressed earnings. To improve results, the company said it is embarking upon an expanded advertising and promotional program, reevaluating the staffing of its branded fast-food installations, and making changes to improve the labor efficiences within those operations.
Uni-Mart operates 398 convenience stores in Pennsylvania, Virginia, New York, New Jersey Delaware and Maryland. Self-service gasoline is offered at 300 locations.
